演唱会快乐升级｜氹仔深夜美食终极指南

2026 年 11 月 14 日·已核实 4 家 ·跳到评论

终于等到安可落幕，场馆的灯光大亮。嗓子又干又哑，浑身上下都好累，我随着乌泱泱的人群一点点挪出金光综艺馆。掏出手机，屏幕跳出来接近午夜十二点的时间。

肚子饿得咕咕叫，我开始寻找有关澳门宵夜的美食攻略，但直到一整天没充电的手机弹出电量提醒的那一刻，我才猛然反应过来，想要在看完演唱会之后找一家合适的餐厅，吃一顿称心的夜宵，远比想象中折腾。

外面到处都是散场的观众，接驳巴士的队伍绕了一圈又一圈，想站在路边伸手拦的士，却一辆辆全是满载。放眼四周全是度假村酒店，装潢精致的高档餐厅安安静静立在路边，好看是好看，价格却不亲民，而且大部分十一点就已经打烊。

我翻开收藏的澳门美食清单。那些被无数人夸赞的本地老店，例如官也街的粥铺和老城区的小吃店，查看营业时间，发现早就关门了。大半夜特地打车过去，也只会扑个空。

这里不像内地城市，随处都有大把 24 小时营业的餐馆。能选择的美食寥寥无几。我和同行的朋友面面相觑，摆在眼前的好像只剩几个很无奈的选项：要么咬咬牙走进昂贵的酒店餐厅，要么将就仅有的几家简餐，再不然，就饿着肚子直接离开。

千里迢迢过来追一场演唱会，难道最后的夜晚就要这样草草收场？

我重新点开社交软件刷夜宵攻略，结果越刷越纠结。铺天盖地的探店笔记看得人眼花缭乱，图片一张比一张诱人，可你根本分不清这家是本地人会去的老店，还是专门做游客生意的网红店。最头疼的是，帖子里常常不写准确的营业时间，不知道现在过去是否还在营业。

人累到脑子转不动的时候，真的没有多余力气去一条条核对营业时间、比对距离、筛选评价。越看越混乱，我们站在路口，差点就打算放弃，随便对付一口算了。

就在这时候，一位本地的阿姨从旁边经过。她看我们举着手机在原地打转，停下来问了一句：“你们是刚看完演唱会的吧？”

我们连忙点头。她抬手往前面一指，语气很平常：“不用在这儿找了。我告诉你们几家店，他们都营业到半夜，而且都在一条街上。”

她一共说了四家餐厅：肥仔文、串嘴爸爸、杨枝金捞和糖朝盛世。

表示完感谢，我们打开导航动身前往那条街。一天行程的疲惫，在看到几家店里的热闹景象后，化成了对美食的期待。

那天晚上我们才明白，不是澳门没有好吃的，是我们被一堆眼花缭乱的信息误导了。

所以我们根据我们的经历，为大家准备了下面这份攻略。

一条街，四家店

适用时间：散场后至凌晨三点

四家店：都在同一条马路上，彼此步行几分钟

跳到街区地图 · 跳到逐家介绍

店营业到人均此刻适合谁
肥仔文03:00MOP 130–150又累又饿，想吃一口热的
串嘴爸爸03:00MOP 100–150情绪没平复，想热闹聊天
杨枝金捞02:00MOP 50–60只想吃口甜的，吃不下正餐
糖朝盛世01:30MOP 45–60榴莲控，想喝一碗糖水收尾

这条街在哪

氹仔孙逸仙博士大马路，四家店的门牌都在 460 到 611 之间。

示意图，比例非实测。四家店总跨度约 560 米，全程步行 8 分钟以内。

这条街的好处不是店多，是店近。你不需要在地图上标四个点、算四条路、比四家评分——从街口走到街尾，能选的都在眼前。

① 肥仔文 fei chai man mei sek

17:00 – 03:00
人均 MOP 130–150
孙逸仙博士大马路 460 号 华峰阁地下 I 铺

为什么选它
散场后最需要的是「热的、软的、不用嚼太久」的东西。水蟹粥正好是这个质地，而且它开得比大多数店都晚。
到了点什么
水蟹粥一锅（两人份够），加一份竹升面或豉油王炒面。粥是现熬的，蟹味浓，别一开始就加调料。
注意什么
散场高峰（23:30–00:30）要等位，20 分钟起。人均在四家里最高，一个人来吃不太划算。

② 串嘴爸爸烧烤 Chun Zui Papa

18:00 – 03:00
人均 MOP 100–150
孙逸仙博士大马路 611 号 海怡花园地下 J 铺

为什么选它
看完演出话还没说完，需要一张能坐很久的桌子。炭火味和吵一点的音量，刚好接住还没落地的情绪。
到了点什么
烤串按人头点，两个人 20 串起。隔壁酸辣粉店是同一个门口的味道，加了本地小米辣，怕辣要先说。
注意什么
周六散场排队 40 分钟起，能线上取号就先取。赶末班车回珠海或香港的话，这家不适合。

③ 杨枝金捞 golden mix dessert

11:30 – 02:00
人均 MOP 50–60
孙逸仙博士大马路 606 号 泉澧花园地下 C 铺

为什么选它
喊了一整晚，嗓子和胃都在发烫，只想吃一口冰的、甜的。这家开到两点，是四家里最轻的选择。
到了点什么
招牌杨枝金捞：芒果肉、西柚粒、一球芒果雪糕。两个人分一碗就够，别点主食。
注意什么
招牌每天沽清，卖完就没了，晚到可能只剩基础款。深夜排队是常态。

④ 糖朝盛世 the golden tang dessert

15:00 – 01:30 左右
人均 MOP 45–60
泉鸿花园地下 O 铺（酸辣粉店旁）

为什么选它
杨枝金捞沽清或排不上时的备选，同一条街，走路两分钟。榴莲系列和椰皇奶冻是它的强项。
到了点什么
榴莲爱好者直接点榴莲系列；不吃榴莲就点椰皇奶冻，整颗椰子端上来，凉的，收尾刚好。
注意什么
四家里收得最早（约 01:30），散场太晚就别指望它了。深夜部分品类会卖空。

小贴士

  • 散场已经过了一点半——糖朝盛世基本收了，直接去肥仔文或串嘴爸爸。
  • 要赶末班车回珠海或香港——烧烤和粥都要等，选杨枝金捞，吃完就走。
温馨提示。营业时间以店家现场公告为准，节假日与演出日可能延长或调整。如发现哪家店关门了、涨价了、或者营业时间变了，欢迎大家在评论区告诉我们。

Concert Night Level Up | The Ultimate Guide to Taipa’s Late-Night Food

14 November 2026·4 shops verified ·jump to comments

After the final encore and the venue lights came up. My throat was dry and hoarse, and my whole body ached. I shuffled out of Galaxy Arena with the crowd. I checked my phone, it’s nearly midnight.

My stomach was growling, so I started searching for late-night food guides for Macau. Then my phone, which had not been charged all day, flashed a low-battery warning — and that was when it hit me: finding a decent late-night meal after a concert takes far more effort than I expected.

Outside, the audience had spilled onto the street. The shuttle bus queue curled around and around, and every taxi I tried to flag was already full. All around were resort hotels, their polished restaurants standing quietly by the roadside — lovely to look at, but not exactly cheap, and most of them had already closed at eleven.

I opened the Macau food list I had saved. The shops that locals recommended, like the congee shops on Rua do Cunha, the snack stalls in the old town are already closed. Taking a taxi there at this time would most likely just mean standing outside a locked door.

Unlike mainland cities, where 24-hour restaurants are everywhere, they are much harder to find here. The options here were very few. My friend and I looked at each other. It seemed we had only a few sad options left: pay for an expensive hotel restaurant, settle for one of the casual places, or just leave hungry.

After coming all this way for just one show, was the last night really going to end like this?

I opened social media again to look for late-night guides, and the more I scrolled, the more confused I got. Review after review, each photo more tempting than the last — but I could not tell whether a place was somewhere locals actually go or a shop built for tourists. The most annoying part was that most posts never gave exact opening hours, so I had no idea whether a place would still be serving if I went now.

When you are that tired, you simply do not have the energy to cross-check opening hours, compare distances and sift through reviews one by one. The more I read, the messier it got. Standing at the corner, we were about to give up and just eat whatever was closest.

Just then, a local auntie walked by. She saw the two of us standing there, phones in hand, going in circles, and stopped. She asked “You just came out of the concert, right?”.

We nodded. She pointed down the road ahead, matter-of-fact: “Don’t bother looking around here. Let me tell you a few places. They all stay open till late, and they are all on the same street.”

She named four restaurants: Fei Chai Man Mei Sek, Chun Zui Papa, Golden Mix Dessert and The Golden Tang Dessert.

After thanking her, we opened the map and set off for that street. The tiredness of a whole day out turned into anticipation for the food.

That night we realized Macau wasn’t short on great food; we had just been misled by all the online noise.

So, based on our own experience, we have created the following guide to help you get started.

One Street, Four Shops

Four shops, one table

Applicable Hours: after the show, until 3 am

Locations of the four shops: all on one avenue, minutes apart on foot

Jump to the map · Jump to the shops

ShopOpen untilPer personBest for
Fei Chai Man Mei Sek03:00MOP 130–150Exhausted and hungry, want something hot
Chun Zui Papa03:00MOP 100–150Still buzzing, want a loud table
Golden Mix Dessert02:00MOP 50–60Too tired for a meal, just want something cold
The Golden Tang Dessert01:30MOP 45–60Durian fan, want a sweet ending

Where the street is

Avenida do Dr. Sun Yat-Sen in Taipa. All four shops sit between numbers 460 and 611.

The advantage is not that there are many shops. It is that they are close. You do not have to drop four pins, work out four routes and compare four ratings — walk one street and everything is in front of you.

① Fei Chai Man Mei Sek

17:00 – 03:00
MOP 130–150 per person
460 Avenida do Dr. Sun Yat-Sen

Why
After a show you want something hot, soft and easy to swallow. Crab congee is exactly that, and it stays open later than most.
Order
One pot of crab congee (enough for two) plus bamboo-shoot or fried noodles. It is cooked to order — do not season it before tasting.
Watch out
Expect a 20-minute wait between 23:30 and 00:30. Highest spend of the four; not great value if you are alone.

② Chun Zui Papa

18:00 – 03:00
MOP 100–150 per person
611 Avenida do Dr. Sun Yat-Sen

Why
You are not done talking about the show yet and need a table you can sit at for an hour. Charcoal smoke and a bit of noise match the mood.
Order
Skewers by the head count — 20 for two. The spicy-sour noodle shop next door uses local small chilli; ask for mild if you need to.
Watch out
Saturday queues start at 40 minutes. Join the virtual waiting list if you can. Skip this if you have a last bus to catch.

③ Golden Mix Dessert

11:30 – 02:00
MOP 50–60 per person
606 Avenida do Dr. Sun Yat-Sen

Why
You have been shouting for three hours and your throat is hot. You want something cold and sweet, and this is the lightest option on the street.
Order
The signature mango dessert: fresh mango, pomelo, a scoop of mango ice cream. One bowl for two is enough. Skip the mains.
Watch out
The signature sells out daily. Come late and you may only get the basic version.

④ The Golden Tang Dessert

15:00 – 01:30 approx.
MOP 45–60 per person
Shop O, Chun Hong Garden

Why
The backup when Golden Mix Dessert is sold out or packed — two minutes away on the same street. Strong on coconut and durian desserts.
Order
Durian series if you like durian; otherwise the chilled coconut jelly, served in the whole coconut. A clean way to end the night.
Watch out
Closes earliest of the four (around 01:30). Do not count on it after a late show.

Tips

  • After 01:30 — The Golden Tang Dessert is closing. Go to Fei Chai Man or Chun Zui Papa.
  • If you have a last bus to catch — congee and BBQ both involve waiting. Pick the dessert shop.
Good to know. Opening hours follow the shop’s own notice and may change on show days and public holidays. If you find a shop closed, a price change or a changed opening hour, let us know in the comments.
